verdict.rationale: The docs show the agent pulls context itself rather than relying on hand-picked files. Projects give agents "all of the context required for your codebase" across one or more folders, and agents can delegate "extensive codebase searches" to built-in subagents. The agent also autonomously reads files with built-in filesystem tools and a context-management loop, and Artifacts can include architecture diagrams, which supports mapping and explaining a codebase. missing for 10: an explicit documented codebase-indexing or whole-repo explanation feature, any stated limits on how large a codebase it can handle, and independent or hands-on corroboration of codebase comprehension quality.
